intro: Organic 1% Milk at CAVA offers a wholesome, nutrient-rich beverage option that perfectly complements your Mediterranean meal. Made from certified organic lowfat milk, this drink provides essential protein and calcium while keeping calories in check. Whether you are building a bowl from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) or enjoying a pita, this organic dairy option adds nutritional value to your dining experience at CAVA.
priceCalories: Priced between $2.75 and $3.15, CAVA's Organic 1% Milk delivers 110 calories per serving. This beverage provides excellent nutritional value with 8 grams of protein, 13 grams of carbohydrates, and just 2 grams of fat. Compare this drink with other options on the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) to find your perfect pairing for a balanced Mediterranean meal.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this beverage apart is its certified organic sourcing and clean ingredient list. CAVA's commitment to quality means you get pure organic 1% lowfat milk with no additives or artificial ingredients. The organic certification ensures the milk comes from cows raised without antibiotics or synthetic hormones, aligning with CAVA's Mediterranean-inspired focus on wholesome, natural ingredients throughout their [full CAVA menu](//).
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Organic 1% Milk contains 110 calories with a balanced macronutrient profile: 8 grams of protein for muscle support, 13 grams of carbohydrates for energy, and 2 grams of fat. This lowfat option provides essential calcium and vitamin D while maintaining a lean nutritional profile. Use the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to see how this drink fits into your daily nutritional goals.
whatsInside: The ingredient list could not be simpler: organic 1% lowfat milk. This single-ingredient beverage contains no preservatives, artificial flavors, or added sugars. The organic certification guarantees the milk comes from pasture-raised cows fed organic feed. This transparency aligns with CAVA's commitment to quality ingredients, similar to those found across their [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) and other menu categories.
tasteLike: Organic 1% Milk delivers a clean, naturally sweet dairy flavor with a smooth, light texture. The lowfat content provides a refreshing mouthfeel without the heaviness of whole milk. The organic quality ensures a pure milk taste free from any off-flavors or aftertastes. This beverage offers a familiar, comforting flavor that serves as a neutral complement to CAVA's bold Mediterranean spices and seasonings.
customize: While Organic 1% Milk comes as a standalone beverage, you can customize your CAVA experience by pairing it strategically with your meal choices. Consider ordering it alongside spicier options from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) to balance heat. The milk's natural sweetness and protein content make it an ideal complement to savory bowls and pitas, creating a balanced nutritional profile for your complete meal.
pairsWell: This organic milk pairs exceptionally well with CAVA's spicier menu items, helping to cool the palate. It complements the rich flavors found in options from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) and works beautifully alongside sweeter items from the [CAVA Desserts Menu](/menu/desserts). The protein content makes it particularly suitable when paired with grain-based bowls, creating a complete, balanced meal that satisfies and nourishes.
healthyChoice: Organic 1% Milk stands out as a nutritious beverage choice, providing 8 grams of high-quality protein to support muscle maintenance and satiety. The organic certification ensures you avoid synthetic hormones and antibiotics. With only 2 grams of fat, it offers essential nutrients like calcium and vitamin D without excessive calories. This makes it a smart choice for those monitoring their intake while still wanting nutrient-dense options.
whoShouldTry: This beverage is ideal for health-conscious diners seeking organic options, fitness enthusiasts needing post-workout protein, and families wanting wholesome choices for children. Those following the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) will appreciate this naturally gluten-free option. Anyone preferring simple, clean ingredients over sugary sodas or artificially flavored drinks should consider this organic milk as their CAVA beverage choice.
howToOrder: Order Organic 1% Milk directly from your server or at the counter when building your CAVA meal. It is available at all [CAVA Locations](/locations) as part of the beverage lineup. Simply add it to your order alongside your customized bowl or pita. The milk comes ready to drink, requiring no additional preparation, making it a convenient, grab-and-go option for busy diners.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Classic Lemonade at 260-360 calories, Organic 1% Milk offers significantly fewer calories at just 110 while providing 8 grams of protein that lemonade lacks. Unlike the Blueberry Lavender options with 140-190 calories and added sugars, this milk delivers natural nutrition without artificial sweeteners. For those prioritizing protein and calcium over fruity refreshment, the organic milk provides superior nutritional value per dollar spent.
worthTrying: Organic 1% Milk is absolutely worth trying for anyone seeking a wholesome, protein-rich beverage at CAVA. Its clean ingredient list, organic certification, and balanced nutrition make it a smart choice that supports your health goals. At $2.75-$3.15, it offers excellent value for a certified organic product. Whether you are health-focused or simply prefer natural beverages, this milk enhances your Mediterranean dining experience with pure, simple nutrition.
